input.quote: 11.1 Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
input.rationale: Sections 11.2 and 11.3 already deliver the playbook's data-return (30 days, machine-readable) and certified-deletion elements, but Section 11.1 sits at the walk-away position: it requires immediate cessation of all assistance and permanent deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support, and it contradicts 11.2/11.3 and the "agreed transition period" contemplated by Section 10.1. Replacing 11.1 with up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, subordinated to the 11.2/11.3 return-then-delete sequence, is the minimal edit reaching the preferred position; 90 days remains available as a fallback.

proposal.summary: Replace immediate cessation/deletion in 11.1 with up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, preserving the data return and deletion sequence in 11.2–11.3.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 11.1 as drafted requires immediate deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support, which contradicts Sections 11.2 and 11.3 and the transition period contemplated by Section 10.1. We have replaced it with our standard position: at our request, up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, with Customer Data returned and then deleted and certified under 11.2 and 11.3; we can accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: On expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months after the effective date of expiry or termination at Vendor's then-current rates, including continued access to the affected Services, knowledge transfer, and reasonable migration support. Vendor shall not delete or withhold Customer Data except in accordance with Sections 11.2 and 11.3.
